repeatability.scope: Same current code and same source PDF; ordered page-block JSON, page layout, layout analysis and four automatic image hashes compared separately

pytest_attempt.message: No module named pytest; no tests were executed by this attempt

full_tests.fallback_note: The complete same tests directory was then run with the available standard-library unittest discovery; no test filter or assertion relaxation was used.

limitations: General heading and section ancestry remain heuristic. In the final Poppler artifacts, BERT target captions still carry Abstract as section_path, while DETR and LoRA target caption paths are empty; answers therefore use physical pages and block IDs rather than claiming verified section hierarchy.
A unique numeric margin candidate can remain ambiguous. Multiple numeric blocks in one margin band are retained in the main flow with a warning, not proven to be page numbers or table cells.

Automatic table candidates and Poppler raw blocks do not establish two-dimensional table structure or numeric-cell ownership. A raw Poppler column block can contain a header and subsequent numbers without proving recovered cells.
Recovered XML control code points are not verified printed-glyph meanings or OCR output. Other malformed XML, invalid UTF, unescaped ampersands and reserved-marker collisions remain fatal.
Geometric subscript joining and floating-text partitioning are audited heuristics with target-page review, not universal typography recovery.

Cross-version physical equality does not establish semantic reading-order equivalence. Earlier raw-ID comparisons identified local DETR page 2 and page 12 order changes; no full-document order gold was created for the nine runs.
ResNet remains partial: Table 1 has one true column-heading row, followed by conv1 and multiline convolution data; those data cells are not promoted to a qualifying multiline header.

Token quantities are per-case heuristic estimates, not Host tokenizer measurements or proof of total conversation usage. Local valid=true is not scientific correctness, official evaluator accuracy, Host discovery, or complete visual review.
